tools.name: fluff_check_filler
tools.description: Use when the user asks to tighten, shorten or cut the fluff from an email, memo, post, report or essay, or asks how much of a text is filler. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fluff_check_filler · Public sink: fluff_check_filler.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fluff_check_filler · Public sink: fluff_check_filler

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
